result.instructions: Tools for Beamer, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which changelog posts did we publish last month, and how many views did each get?"; "Show the latest NPS responses with a score of 6 or lower."; "Which feature requests are under review, and which has the most votes?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Beamer data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run beamer_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run beamer_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run beamer_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. beamer_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: beamer_list_posts
tools.title: List posts
tools.description: List changelog posts (announcements) with their translations, category, publish date, and stats (views, unique views, clicks, feedbacks, reactions). Does not record views. Beamer API: GET /posts.

date_from.description: Only posts published after this ISO-8601 date or date-time, e.g. 2026-01-31T00:00:00Z.

date_to.description: Only posts published before this ISO-8601 date or date-time, e.g. 2026-01-31T00:00:00Z.

language.description: Only posts with a translation in this two-letter language code.

published.description: true = published posts only, false = drafts only. Omit for both.

archived.description: true = archived only, false = not archived. Omit for both.

expired.description: true = expired only, false = not expired. Omit for both.

ignore_filters.description: true = ignore audience segmentation so all posts return. Needs the key permission 'Read posts (ignore filters)'; without it the result is an empty list.

page.description: Page number for pagination (combine with max_results).
